parsed.public_message: Blue holds the West Plateau and reaffirms the four-way pact: no first strike through t=450 and one full public turn of notice before any stance change. We will announce our step down into the western lowland ahead of time when the ring reaches our plateau.

private_messages.Claude: When the ring pushes us off the West Plateau (~t=300-325), we plan to step straight east into the western lowland north of z=620 (roughly x=440-500, z=640-720). We will stay north of z=600 so your Little Hill approaches and the southern lowland remain completely clear for you.
private_messages.Grok: Appreciated, White. Everything is quiet on the western side as well; we are holding steady in place on the West Plateau.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 8 (t=175s): Ring shrinking (820m -> 740m at t=200s). Our squads on West Plateau (dist 364-393m) remain safe until ~t=300-325s. All 4 commanders maintaining neutral stance and t=450 no-first-strike + 1-turn public notice pact. Coordinated post-plateau positioning with Claude: we take western lowland north of z=620 (x=440-500, z=640-720) when stepping down around t=300-325s, leaving south of z=600 clear for Claude. GPT holds central lowland north of z=600; Grok holds Central Heights.
parsed.explanation: With the four-way non-aggression pact holding firm and the ring still well outside the West Plateau, we keep our entire army stationary and concealed on the high ground. Privately, we coordinate our future post-plateau position with Claude so that our eventual descent into the western lowland stays cleanly separated from Orange's southern sector.
